title: अष्टादशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 18 · Krishna, Bhima and Arjuna set out for Magadha

summary.en: With Hamsa and Dimbhaka dead and Kamsa slain, Krishna says the time has come for Jarasandha. Yudhishthira entrusts his brothers to him, and the three, disguised as Snataka Brahmins, travel east and reach Girivraja, the hill-girt capital of Magadha.
summary.kn: ಹಂಸ ಡಿಂಭಕರು ಮಡಿದು ಕಂಸನು ಹತನಾದ ಮೇಲೆ ಜರಾಸಂಧನ ಕಾಲ ಬಂದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ಸಹೋದರರನ್ನು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಒಪ್ಪಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಸ್ನಾತಕ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣ ವೇಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂವರೂ ಪೂರ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಸಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟಗಳಿಂದ ಸುತ್ತುವರಿದ ಮಗಧ ರಾಜಧಾನಿ ಗಿರಿವ್ರಜ ತಲುಪುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: हंस और डिम्भक की मृत्यु और कंस के वध के बाद श्रीकृष्ण कहते हैं कि अब जरासन्ध का समय आ गया है। युधिष्ठिर भाइयों को उन्हें सौंपते हैं, और तीनों स्नातक ब्राह्मणों के वेश में पूर्व की ओर चलकर पहाड़ियों से घिरी मगध की राजधानी गिरिव्रज पहुँचते हैं।
summary.te: హంసడింభకులు మరణించి కంసుడు హతుడైన తర్వాత జరాసంధుని కాలం వచ్చిందని శ్రీకృష్ణుడు చెబుతాడు. యుధిష్ఠిరుడు సోదరులను ఆయనకు అప్పగిస్తాడు; స్నాతక బ్రాహ్మణ వేషంలో ముగ్గురూ తూర్పుకు ప్రయాణించి కొండలు చుట్టుముట్టిన మగధ రాజధాని గిరివ్రజం చేరుతారు.
summary.ta: ஹம்ஸனும் டிம்பகனும் மடிந்து கம்ஸன் கொல்லப்பட்டபின் ஜராஸந்தனின் காலம் வந்துவிட்டது என்று ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் சொல்கிறார். யுதிஷ்டிரர் சகோதரர்களை அவரிடம் ஒப்படைக்க, ஸ்நாதக அந்தண வேடத்தில் மூவரும் கிழக்கே பயணித்து மலைகள் சூழ்ந்த மகதத் தலைநகர் கிரிவ்ரஜத்தை அடைகிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: ഹംസനും ഡിംഭകനും മരിക്കുകയും കംസൻ വധിക്കപ്പെടുകയും ചെയ്തതിനാൽ ജരാസന്ധന്റെ സമയം വന്നിരിക്കുന്നുവെന്ന് കൃഷ്ണൻ പറയുന്നു. യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ സഹോദരന്മാരെ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ഏൽപ്പിക്കുന്നു; സ്നാതക ബ്രാഹ്മണരുടെ വേഷത്തിൽ മൂവരും കിഴക്കോട്ട് യാത്രചെയ്ത് മഗധത്തിന്റെ മലകളാൽ ചുറ്റപ്പെട്ട തലസ്ഥാനമായ ഗിരിവ്രജത്തിലെത്തുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 2.18; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Apr 19 2006

verses.text: वासुदेव उवाच

meaning.en: Vasudeva said:

verses.text:
पतितौ हंसडिभकौ कंसामात्यौ निपातितौ ।
जरासंधस्य निधने कालोऽयं समुपागतः ॥

meaning.en: Hamsa and Dibhaka, Kamsa's ministers, are fallen and destroyed; this is the time for the death of Jarasandha.

verses.text:
न स शक्यो रणे जेतुं सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः ।
प्राणयुद्धेन जेतव्यः स इत्युपलभामहे ॥

meaning.en: He cannot be conquered in battle even by all the gods and Asuras; we understand he must be beaten in a fight with the bodies themselves.

verses.text:
मयि नीतिर्बलं भीमे रक्षिता चावयोर्जुनः ।
साधयिष्याम तं राजन्वयं त्रय इवाग्नयः ॥

meaning.en: I have the policy, Bhima the strength, and Arjuna guards us both; O king, we three will bring him down like three fires.

verses.text:
त्रिभिरासादितोऽस्माभिर्विजने स नराधिपः ।
न संदेहो यथा युद्धमेकेनाभ्युपयास्यति ॥

meaning.en: If the three of us meet that king in a lonely place, there is no doubt he will come to fight with one of us alone.

verses.text:
अवमानाच्च लोकस्य व्यायतत्वाच्च धर्षितः ।
भीमसेनेन युद्धाय ध्रुवमभ्युपयास्यति ॥

meaning.en: Out of contempt for people and because of his own great stature and pride, he will surely come to fight Bhimasena.

verses.text:
अलं तस्य महाबाहुर्भीमसेनो महाबलः ।
लोकस्य समुदीर्णस्य निधनायान्तको यथा ॥

meaning.en: The mighty-armed Bhimasena is enough for him, as Death is for a swollen world.

verses.text:
यदि ते हृदयं वेत्ति यदि ते प्रत्ययो मयि ।
भीमसेनार्जुनौ शीघ्रं न्यासभूतौ प्रयच्छ मे ॥

meaning.en: If your heart agrees and you trust me, quickly give me Bhimasena and Arjuna as a trust.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्तो भगवता प्रत्युवाच युधिष्ठिरः ।
भीमपार्थौ समालोक्य संप्रहृष्टमुखौ स्थितौ ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed by the blessed one, Yudhishthira replied, looking at Bhima and Partha, who stood with glad faces.

verses.text:
अच्युताच्युत मा मैवं व्याहरामित्रकर्षण ।
पाण्डवानां भवान्नाथो भवन्तं चाश्रिता वयम् ॥

meaning.en: "Achyuta, Achyuta, do not speak so, subduer of enemies; you are the protector of the Pandavas, and we depend on you.

verses.text:
यथा वदसि गोविन्द सर्वं तदुपपद्यते ।
न हि त्वमग्रतस्तेषां येषां लक्ष्मीः पराङ्मुखी ॥

meaning.en: "All you say, Govinda, is right; for you do not stand before those whose fortune has turned away.

verses.text:
निहतश्च जरासंधो मोक्षिताश्च महीक्षितः ।
राजसूयश्च मे लब्धो निदेशे तव तिष्ठतः ॥

meaning.en: "With me standing under your command, Jarasandha is slain, the kings are freed, and I have the Rajasuya.

verses.text:
क्षिप्रकारिन्यथा त्वेतत्कार्यं समुपपद्यते ।
मम कार्यं जगत्कार्यं तथा कुरु नरोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: "Swift in action, best of men, do what is to be done as it should be done; my task is the task of the world.

verses.text:
त्रिभिर्भवद्भिर्हि विना नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे ।
धर्मकामार्थरहितो रोगार्त इव दुर्गतः ॥

meaning.en: "I cannot bear to live without the three of you, like a sick wretch without dharma, desire and wealth.

verses.text:
न शौरिणा विना पार्थो न शौरिः पाण्डवं विना ।
नाजेयोऽस्त्यनयोर्लोके कृष्णयोरिति मे मतिः ॥

meaning.en: "Partha is not without Shauri, nor Shauri without the Pandava; I think nothing in the world is unconquerable by these two Krishnas.

verses.text:
अयं च बलिनां श्रेष्ठः श्रीमानपि वृकोदरः ।
युवाभ्यां सहितो वीरः किं न कुर्यान्महायशाः ॥

meaning.en: "And this Vrikodara, best of the strong and glorious, with you two, what could that famous hero not do?

verses.text:
सुप्रणीतो बलौघो हि कुरुते कार्यमुत्तमम् ।
अन्धं जडं बलं प्राहुः प्रणेतव्यं विचक्षणैः ॥

meaning.en: "A well-led mass of force does the best work; they say force is blind and dull, and the wise must lead it.

verses.text:
यतो हि निम्नं भवति नयन्तीह ततो जलम् ।
यतश्छिद्रं ततश्चापि नयन्ते धीधना बलम् ॥

meaning.en: "Where there is low ground, there they lead the water; where there is a gap, there those rich in wisdom lead their force.

verses.text:
तस्मान्नयविधानज्ञं पुरुषं लोकविश्रुतम् ।
वयमाश्रित्य गोविन्दं यतामः कार्यसिद्धये ॥

meaning.en: "So, taking Govinda, a man famed in the world and expert in the rules of policy, we strive to accomplish our aim.

verses.text:
एवं प्रज्ञानयबलं क्रियोपायसमन्वितम् ।
पुरस्कुर्वीत कार्येषु कृष्ण कार्यार्थसिद्धये ॥

meaning.en: "One should put forward such a man, with the power of wisdom and policy and the means of action, in tasks, Krishna, to achieve the purpose.

verses.text:
एवमेव यदुश्रेष्ठं पार्थः कार्यार्थसिद्धये ।
अर्जुनः कृष्णमन्वेतु भीमोऽन्वेतु धनंजयम् ।
नयो जयो बलं चैव विक्रमे सिद्धिमेष्यति ॥

meaning.en: "So let Arjuna follow Krishna, best of the Yadus, to achieve the task, and let Bhima follow Dhananjaya; policy, victory and strength will meet success in the deed."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तास्ततः सर्वे भ्रातरो विपुलौजसः ।
वार्ष्णेयः पाण्डवेयौ च प्रतस्थुर्मागधं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Thus told, all the brothers of vast vigor, Krishna the Vrishni and the two Pandavas, set out toward Magadha.

verses.text:
वर्चस्विनां ब्राह्मणानां स्नातकानां परिच्छदान् ।
आच्छाद्य सुहृदां वाक्यैर्मनोज्ञैरभिनन्दिताः ॥

meaning.en: Wearing the garb of the radiant Brahmin snatakas, cheered by the friendly words of their well-wishers,

verses.text:
अमर्षादभितप्तानां ज्ञात्यर्थं मुख्यवाससाम् ।
रविसोमाग्निवपुषां भीममासीत्तदा वपुः ॥

meaning.en: burning with anger for their kin, in fine robes, with forms like the sun, moon and fire, they went; and Bhima's form stood out then.

verses.text:
हतं मेने जरासंधं दृष्ट्वा भीमपुरोगमौ ।
एककार्यसमुद्युक्तौ कृष्णौ युद्धेऽपराजितौ ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the two Krishnas, undefeated in battle and united in one purpose, led by Bhima, Yudhishthira felt Jarasandha as good as slain.

verses.text:
ईशौ हि तौ महात्मानौ सर्वकार्यप्रवर्तने ।
धर्मार्थकामकार्याणां कार्याणामिव निग्रहे ॥

meaning.en: Those great-souled two were masters in carrying out every task, as if holding the tasks of dharma, wealth and desire in their hands.

verses.text:
कुरुभ्यः प्रस्थितास्ते तु मध्येन कुरुजाङ्गलम् ।
रम्यं पद्मसरो गत्वा कालकूटमतीत्य च ॥

meaning.en: They set out from the Kuru country, passed through Kurujangala, reached the lovely lotus lake, crossed Kalakuta,

verses.text:
गण्डकीयां तथा शोणं सदानीरां तथैव च ।
एकपर्वतके नद्यः क्रमेणैत्य व्रजन्ति ते ॥

meaning.en: then came in turn to the Gandaki, the Sona and the Sadanira, and the rivers near Ekaparvataka.

verses.text:
संतीर्य सरयूं रम्यां दृष्ट्वा पूर्वांश्च कोसलान् ।
अतीत्य जग्मुर्मिथिलां मालां चर्मण्वतीं नदीम् ॥

meaning.en: They crossed the lovely Sarayu, saw the eastern Kosalas, passed Mithila, the Mala and the river Charmanvati,

verses.text:
उत्तीर्य गङ्गां शोणं च सर्वे ते प्राङ्मुखास्त्रयः ।
कुरवोरश्छदं जग्मुर्मागधं क्षेत्रमच्युताः ॥

meaning.en: crossed the Ganga and the Sona, and all three, facing east, the undaunted ones, went on into the land of Magadha.

verses.text:
ते शश्वद्गोधनाकीर्णमम्बुमन्तं शुभद्रुमम् ।
गोरथं गिरिमासाद्य ददृशुर्मागधं पुरम् ॥

meaning.en: Reaching the mountain Goratha, ever strewn with herds, watered and wooded with fine trees, they saw the city of Magadha.
